# ERCOT Large Load Tracker

> Tracks ERCOT's Large-Load Queue (data center, crypto, industrial) over time, using ERCOT's own public committee filings. Built and maintained by Kardashev Labs.

Site: https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org

This site answers three questions with public data, not forecasts or opinion:
- How much Large Load is in ERCOT's queue, and how has that changed month to month?
- Which CDR Zones can absorb new Large Load, based on queue depth, generation-side Full Process, and Settlement Zone stress? Each Zone Scorecard carries a Mark (A–D), not a Clearance Band.
- Line Ahead: given size, LLWG Split, and type, what does arithmetic on Filing Observations say? Not a forecast, not a Clearance, not a time-to-power promise.

## Data sources

- ERCOT Large Load Working Group (LLWG) and Large Flexible Load Task Force (LFLTF) monthly decks: Filing Observations. Latest-per-month is a view.
- ERCOT Generator Interconnection Status (GIS) Report: GIS Film Full Process by CDR Zone and fuel, used as the closest available stand-in for Large-Load clocks (ERCOT does not yet publish those directly).
- ERCOT wholesale LMP history by Settlement Zone, used as a stress proxy (spike frequency, negative-price frequency). Negative prices are Markets stress, not Published Curtailment.

Full sourcing and known limitations: https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/methodology

## Pages

- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/: Overview: tracked queue history, month-over-month change, Reality Gap (Approved-to-Energize MW versus Observed Energized MW), breakdowns by type and size.
- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/zones: Zone Scorecards: Mark per CDR Zone from queue depth, Full Process, and price stress. Each card names LLWG Split / CDR Zone / Settlement Zone coverage.
- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/estimate: Line Ahead arithmetic from Filing Observations.
- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/batch-zero: Batch Zero as a Large-Load Integration instance (PGRR145, NPRR1325, Senate Bill 6).
- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/report/[month]: Permanent monthly snapshot pages, one per LLWG/LFLTF deck.
- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org/methodology: Full data sourcing, extraction method, and explicit list of what the data cannot tell you.

## Related Kardashev Labs tools

- https://clearance.kardashevlabs.org: Draw an ERCOT Footprint for a county-level Clearance Band
- https://interconnection-queue.kardashevlabs.org/interconnection-timelines: Measured generation-side Full Process
- https://interconnection-queue.kardashevlabs.org: Multi-ISO Current Observation
- https://kardashevlabs.org: Kardashev Labs
- https://docs.kardashevlabs.org: Python / JS client docs

## Notes for reuse

- All numbers trace to a public ERCOT filing; see /methodology for the extraction method.
- Data has real gaps (committee did not meet or publish every month). Gaps are shown as breaks in charts, never interpolated or guessed.
- This is historical data, not a forecast.
